# gamelib-depot synthetic CDN fixtures

Tier 1 parity input (D-14). Each directory under `cases/` is a miniature CDN: the manifests and
encrypted chunks a depot job would fetch, plus a `case.json` describing the job. Both the TS
oracle (`src/backend/storeManagers/steam/__tests__/depotGoldenOracle.ts`, plan 08) and the Rust golden test (`tests/golden.rs`, plan 10)
read the same bytes.

## Layout

```
cases/<name>/case.json                      job description (appId, depots, keys, finalize)
cases/<name>/manifests/<depotId>_<gid>.bin  manifest exactly as a CDN serves it
cases/<name>/chunks/<sha-hex>.bin           encrypted chunk body, named by plaintext SHA1
```

## Cases and the D-14 corpus bullet each covers

| Case                    | Covers                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `zip-deflate`           | zip manifest wrapper; PK deflate chunks (multi-chunk file); one PK stored chunk with a data descriptor and trailing central directory; zero-byte file; directory entry |
| `lzma`                  | VZ (LZMA) chunks                                                                                                                                                       |
| `zstd`                  | VSZa (zstd) chunks and a VSZa manifest wrapper                                                                                                                         |
| `multi-depot-collision` | two depots; a same-path override (`data/a.txt` in both) and a case-only collision (`Data/Readme.txt` against `data/readme.txt`)                                        |
| `modes-macho`           | thin `MH_EXECUTE` and fat `MH_DYLIB` Mach-O files without the exec flag; an Executable file; ReadOnly; ReadOnly and Executable; Hidden; a symlink to a sibling         |
| `encrypted-names`       | VZa manifest wrapper; encrypted filenames; a non-ASCII UTF-8 name                                                                                                      |
| `shared-redist`         | shared-redist job with `finalize: null` and its own install root                                                                                                       |

Manifest ids exceed 2^53 on purpose, to catch any 64-bit id that passes through a JS number.

## Regenerating

```
cargo test -p gamelib-depot --test fixtures_gen -- --ignored regenerate_fixtures
```

`fixtures_are_deterministic` runs in normal `cargo test` and fails if the committed tree differs
from what the generator produces, so a generator change always needs a regeneration commit.
`case.json` is emitted with 2-space indentation and a trailing newline so prettier accepts it;
fix the builder, not the file, if that ever stops being true.

## Rules

- The depot keys are synthetic, derived from the case name and depot id. They are not real Steam
  keys and unlock nothing.
- Content is generated by an inline PRNG. **Never add game content**, however small. Total size is
  capped at 2 MiB by `fixtures_parse_and_stay_small`.
- `expected.json` per case is produced by the TS oracle `depotGoldenOracle.ts` (`pnpm gen:depot-goldens`, plan 08; regeneration needs a case-sensitive volume via `GAMELIB_DEPOT_ORACLE_TMP`)
  before the TS pipeline is deleted, and stays afterwards. A case added after the deletion carries
  a Rust-verified value plus a `divergenceNote`.
